summary.text: Donna White, listed as Donna McDowell White by Ballotpedia and the General Assembly, is a Republican state representative from North Carolina House District 26 in Johnston County who has served since January 1, 2017, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.
The General Assembly lists her occupation as registered nurse and aging specialist.

paragraphs.text: White succeeded Republican Namon Daughtry in House District 26, according to Ballotpedia.

White chairs the House Health Committee and the Appropriations Subcommittee on Health and Human Services, is vice chairman of the Appropriations Committee, and co-chairs the Joint Legislative Oversight Committee on Medicaid.
She also serves on the Higher Education, Rules, Calendar, and Operations of the House, and State and Local Government committees.
